title: Homeowner Contract Terms Summary: Cancellation Period, Restocking Fee, Lead Time and Crew Days for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Contract timeline terms — Replacement System Installations

The following terms of a Replacement System Installations contract are set per package: how long a written proposal can be signed at its quoted price, the statutory cancellation period of a home solicitation sale, the restocking fee on a later cancellation, the equipment lead time before the installation can be scheduled, the working days the crew needs on site, and whether a municipal mechanical permit and inspection are required.

| Package | Proposal can be signed at quoted price (calendar days) | Cancellation period (business days after signing) | Restocking fee (percent of the contract price) | Equipment lead time (business days after the cancellation period ends) | Crew days on site | Municipal permit and inspection required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | 30 | 3 | 15 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | 30 | 3 | 15 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Harbison Performance Series System | 30 | 3 | 15 | 3 | 1 | Yes |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | 30 | 3 | 15 | 3 | 2 | Yes |
| Harbison Signature Series System | 30 | 3 | 20 | 5 | 2 | Yes |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | 30 | 3 | 25 | 10 | 2 | Yes |

## Notes on the terms

- The proposal period is counted in calendar days from the day the proposal is written.
- The cancellation period and the equipment lead time are counted in business days; each is defined in the rule that applies it.
- The restocking fee is a percentage of the contract price of that project.
- Crew days are working days on site.

## Comparisons (hypothetical contracts)

- A hypothetical Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System contract carries a 25 percent restocking fee and a 10 business-day equipment lead time, the longest of any package.
- A hypothetical Harbison Advantage Series System contract carries a 15 percent restocking fee, a 2 business-day lead time and one crew day on site.
- The cancellation period is 3 business days and the proposal period 30 days on every package.
